A local Python tool that parses metes-and-bounds legal descriptions into structured COGO calls, builds preview geometry, checks closure/misclosure, and exports DXF or GeoJSON for mapping workflow testing. No official County data, real APNs, private legal descriptions, Q-drive files, or production records are included. Local Tool, 2025 to present.
